- [RCTS.1.2.17] **`dead_rules_expected`** (optional) — an array of rule
  names, each a string: the rules of `rules_ds` the fixture requires never
  to fire. A harness must fail a fixture whose array names a string that is
  no rule of `rules_ds`. Its firings are judged when its `expect.kind` is
  `runtime_fact_count`, `temporal_sequence`, `adapter_calls`,
  `adapter_cache_sets`, `adapter_cache_deletes`, `adapter_mock`, or a kind
  whose category in [RCTS.1.2.10] is `logical`: these kinds observe every
  rule that fires. For such a fixture, with or without the field, a harness
  must fail it when a rule the array names fires, and when a rule of
  `rules_ds` the array does not name never fires. A harness must fail a
  fixture of any other kind whose array is not empty, because nothing it
  observes can check the array.
